steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your request has been submitted to EDGE for resolution, and after discussion, they have agreed to grant you this opportunity to proceed.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: However, we will be implementing more rigorous safety protocols. We must ensure your protection, as you are invaluable to DisCity.
But with the Third Observatorium and your catastrophe weapon combined, isn't that enough?
That system was built to disrupt catastrophes. Protecting one person should be well within its capabilities.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Based on available data, killing a person is far simpler than protecting one. Warfare often serves as a prime example of that.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Now, to the plan. Phase one: you will approach the Black Ring and identify an entry point.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I will be unable to provide direct support during close-quarters engagement, but I will handle tactical analysis and coordinate FAC and DisCorps squadrons to clear a path for you. Their presence should dilute the direct impact of the Black Ring's Mania.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Phase two: penetration. Once you cross the threshold, you will be alone. No support team, and certainly no Sinners, can follow you inside.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: However, once you are inside BR-005's Mania field, the Third Observatorium will be able to lock onto the unique signature of your shackles. This will allow us to track your position precisely, offer remote protection, and assist in threat neutralization.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Black Ring possesses depth characteristics similar to the DisSea. Hazard levels increase exponentially the closer you move toward the epicenter. If you breach the predetermined safety threshold and we assess your risk level as critical, please follow our extraction orders immediately.
I expected a "fight to the last" kind of objective.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your successful entry is the primary objective. The data we will gather from your incursion is itself a decisive victory.
Having delivered their decision, Schorl falls silent. Its optical sensors sweep over you from head to toe as it performs the last, precise calibrations on your anti-Mania armor.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Good luck, Chief.
[Scene Change]
You step onto Nirvana Port's rooftop pad into the teeth of the storm. The wind lashes your face, and the Mania within you surges in response.

Through the raging veil of sand, you see it: BR-005 and the foremost Apostle move toward you from the storm's heart, a mountain of a figure whose head scrapes the bruised sky. Its form pulses with a twisted, chaotic red light, like a walking calamity. The shackles throb with a painful pull, whispering that your destination has come to you.
Your companion is already ahead. She turns back, waiting for you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't want you to suffer, Chief. I don't want you to get dragged into things I don't understand. This fight... it's not even yours. I care more about you being safe than who wins this war.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But... I really want Hella back, too. She was my first friend. I can't sleep, knowing she's trapped in there.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: So I get it, Chief. I know this must hurt you even more than it hurts me.
Hecate pauses, her teeth catching gently on her lower lip—a gesture you've come to recognize as her struggle for composure.

Over the past few years, you have watched the landscape of her emotions broaden, revealing unexpected depths. But just as you school your own features into a mask of stoicism for the political stage, she is now learning the same difficult art of restraint.
...Or perhaps it is something more. She steps closer, tilting her face up to yours, her eyes holding something silent yet resolute.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: In this battle, you're the only one who can break the Black Ring. And you're the only other one who really wants to save her.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: So please... bring Hella back. I'll be right there with you. No matter what.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I will.
You take her hand.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Mm.
The DisCorps aircraft roars toward your position. You board together and quickly don protective gear, your hands never parting throughout the process.
Between your interlaced palms, dark thorns of light flicker into existence—resonating, stinging, binding you both. This pain is a testament to the unbreakable bond between you and her.
Through the contamination corroding your bodies, at the far end of these extending shackles, deep within the Black Ring now turned into an Apostle, <color=#fb9259>Hella</color> is waiting.
—The three of you have never truly been apart. And soon, you will be reunited.
